findings.rationale: The handler checks its deadline only after detection finishes. Detection waits indefinitely for the shared classifier lock and scores every chunk even after expiration. Concurrent requests can accumulate threads and continue consuming inference resources after router timeouts. Bound admission and check deadlines before lock acquisition and between chunks.
findings.title: Detector deadline does not bound queued classifier work
